origins.section: An Instance Method Is Chosen by the Object; a Static Method by the Declared Type
A Private Method Is Never Overridden, So the Class's Own Calls Keep Using It
Every Argument Is Evaluated, Left to Right, Before the Method Runs
Each Call Holds a Stack Frame Until It Returns, So Recursion Depth Is Limited by the Stack

recorded.prompt:q-currency-symbol: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-currency-symbol: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-currency-symbol: Page: "A static call is resolved by the compiler, from the type of the expression left of the dot." Output for the same shape (Exporter exporter = new CsvExporter(); exporter.extension()): "extension(): dat". Currency c = new Euro(); c.symbol() maps directly to this, so the reader reaches the parent's value (the currency sign) and the declared-type reason.
recorded.prompt:q-report-header: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-report-header: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-report-header: Page: "A private method is not inherited, so `StrictImporter.validate` is a new method that shares a name. `Importer.run` calls its own private method whatever the object is", with output "StrictImporter accepts \"12,x,7\": true" (the parent's check ran). Also "With `@Override` on `StrictImporter.validate` the mistake doesn't compile". Report/QuarterlyReport is the same shape, so REPORT with the separate-method reason follows.
recorded.prompt:q-ledger-entry: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-ledger-entry: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-ledger-entry: Page: "Java evaluates the expression before the dot, then each argument in order, and only then checks the receiver for `null` and enters the method." Output for audit().record(nextSeq(), render("A-7")): "audit()", "nextSeq() -> 42", "render(A-7)", then the NPE; and "The null receiver threw only after both arguments ran, so sequence number 42 went to a record that was never written." Directly decides c.
recorded.prompt:q-category-tree: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-category-tree: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-category-tree: Page: "The limit is bytes of stack. A frame of the interpreted method is larger than the frame of the same method once the JIT has compiled it, and when that happens varies from run to run. So the thread fails after each deploy and loads once the server is warm." Output "just after start: StackOverflowError after 11112 lines" / "after warm-up : rendered 12000 lines". Decides a. Minor: the page's cold failures came at 10,203-11,112 frames, above the stem's 9,000; not a contradiction (frame size depends on the method), but a reader comparing numbers may hesitate.

recorded.prompt:q-currency-symbol:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-currency-symbol:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-currency-symbol:a: Refuted by "An instance call's implementation is chosen when it runs: the JVM looks at the object's class" set against "A static call is resolved by the compiler, from the type of the expression left of the dot", and by the output "extension(): dat" even though the object is a CsvExporter.
recorded.prompt:q-currency-symbol:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-currency-symbol:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-currency-symbol:b: Refuted by "`CsvExporter.extension()` *hides* `Exporter.extension()`" and "`@Override` on a static method fails with `static methods cannot be annotated with @Override`". Reference table: static -> "hides it if static".
recorded.prompt:q-currency-symbol:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-currency-symbol:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-currency-symbol:d: Refuted by "it runs only when the call names `CsvExporter` or an expression of that type", so access is not limited to code inside the subclass. Partly true: its printed value (the parent's sign) is the correct answer; only the reason is wrong. A reader who picks by output alone could land on d.
recorded.prompt:q-report-header:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-report-header:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-report-header:a: Refuted by "`Importer.run` calls its own private method whatever the object is"; the example's object is a StrictImporter (printed via getClass) yet the parent's validate ran. Partly true: render() does run on a QuarterlyReport object; the inference is what is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-report-header:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-report-header:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-report-header:b: Refuted by "A private method is not inherited, so `StrictImporter.validate` is a new method that shares a name" and the Reference row "`private` | the declaring class, at compile time | is a separate method". Partly true: the general rule holds for inherited non-private instance methods ("overrides it if instance").
recorded.prompt:q-report-header:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-report-header:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-report-header:d: Refuted, but only by inference: the page never shows a self-call inside a class dispatching to a subclass override. It says "An instance call's implementation is chosen when it runs: the JVM looks at the object's class and runs its override", the Reference row "instance, not `private`, not `final` | the object's class, at run time", and the advice "make the hook `protected` or package-private" (which only fixes the bug if run()'s call would then reach the override). Partly true: its answer (REPORT) is correct; only the reason is wrong.

recorded.prompt:q-category-tree:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-category-tree:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-category-tree:b: Refuted by implication: the page attributes the change to frame size ("A frame of the interpreted method is larger..."), and gives a fixed configured size: "default thread stack | 1 MB (`ThreadStackSize = 1024`), set with `-Xss`"; "`-Xss2m` ... only moves the limit". The page never states outright that a thread's stack does not grow at run time, so the refutation is indirect. Partly true: "fewer frames just after start" is correct.

recorded.pass:q-category-tree:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-category-tree:c: Refuted by "The limit is bytes of stack" and the output where the same 12,000-reply chain fails just after start and succeeds after warm-up; also "Two more runs failed after 10,203 and 10,972 lines" (no fixed count).
recorded.prompt:q-category-tree:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-category-tree:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-category-tree:d: Refuted by "The limit is bytes of stack" (not a fixed call count). Per-thread stacks are shown by "one thread's stack | `new Thread(group, task, name, stackSize)`" and "-Xss2m ... for every thread that doesn't set its own"; the page does not say explicitly that other threads' calls don't count, but per-thread stacks imply it.
